TRUNCATE TABLE dw.DimCustomer;
INSERT INTO dw.DimCustomer
(
    CustomerID,
    FirstName,
    LastName,
    CompanyName,
    EmailAddress,
    Phone
)
SELECT
    CustomerID,
    FirstName,
    LastName,
    CompanyName,
    EmailAddress,
    Phone
FROM stg.Customer

TRUNCATE TABLE dw.DimProduct;
INSERT INTO dw.DimProduct
(
    ProductID,
    ProductName,
    ProductNumber,
    Color,
    Size,
    StandardCost,
    ListPrice,
    Weight,
    ProductCategoryID,
    CategoryName,
    ParentCategoryName
)
SELECT
    p.ProductID,
    p.Name AS ProductName,
    p.ProductNumber,
    p.Color,
    p.Size,
    p.StandardCost,
    p.ListPrice,
    p.Weight,
    pc.ProductCategoryID,
    pc.Name AS CategoryName,
    parent.Name AS ParentCategoryName
FROM stg.Product p
LEFT JOIN stg.ProductCategory pc
    ON p.ProductCategoryID = pc.ProductCategoryID
LEFT JOIN stg.ProductCategory parent
    ON pc.ParentProductCategoryID = parent.ProductCategoryID;

TRUNCATE TABLE dw.DimDate;

DECLARE @StartDate date = '2000-01-01';
DECLARE @EndDate   date = '2030-12-31';

;WITH DateCTE AS
(
    SELECT @StartDate AS TheDate
    UNION ALL
    SELECT DATEADD(DAY, 1, TheDate)
    FROM DateCTE
    WHERE TheDate < @EndDate
)
INSERT INTO dw.DimDate
(
    DateKey,
    [Date],
    [Year],
    [Quarter],
    [Month],
    MonthName,
    DayOfMonth,
    DayOfWeek
)
SELECT
    CONVERT(int, CONVERT(char(8), TheDate, 112)) AS DateKey,  -- yyyymmdd
    TheDate,
    YEAR(TheDate),
    DATEPART(QUARTER, TheDate),
    MONTH(TheDate),
    DATENAME(MONTH, TheDate),
    DAY(TheDate),

    -- DayOfWeek: Monday=1 ... Sunday=7 (stable, not dependent on DATEFIRST)
    ((DATEDIFF(DAY, '19000101', TheDate) % 7 + 7) % 7) + 1 AS DayOfWeek
FROM DateCTE
OPTION (MAXRECURSION 0);

TRUNCATE TABLE dw.DimAddress;

INSERT INTO dw.DimAddress
(
    AddressID,
    AddressLine1,
    AddressLine2,
    City,
    StateProvince,
    CountryRegion,
    PostalCode
)
SELECT
    a.AddressID,
    a.AddressLine1,
    a.AddressLine2,
    a.City,
    a.StateProvince,
    a.CountryRegion,
    a.PostalCode
FROM stg.Address a;

TRUNCATE TABLE dw.FactSales;

INSERT INTO dw.FactSales
(
    SalesOrderID,
    SalesOrderDetailID,

    DateKey,
    CustomerKey,
    ProductKey,
    ShipToAddressKey,
    BillToAddressKey,

    OrderQty,
    UnitPrice,
    UnitPriceDiscount,
    LineTotal,

    SubTotal,
    TaxAmt,
    Freight,
    TotalDue
)
SELECT
    h.SalesOrderID,
    d.SalesOrderDetailID,

    CONVERT(int, CONVERT(char(8), h.OrderDate, 112)) AS DateKey,

    dc.CustomerKey,
    dp.ProductKey,
    daShip.AddressKey AS ShipToAddressKey,
    daBill.AddressKey AS BillToAddressKey,

    d.OrderQty,
    d.UnitPrice,
    d.UnitPriceDiscount,
    d.LineTotal,

    h.SubTotal,
    h.TaxAmt,
    h.Freight,
    h.TotalDue
FROM stg.SalesOrderHeader h
JOIN stg.SalesOrderDetail d
    ON d.SalesOrderID = h.SalesOrderID
JOIN dw.DimCustomer dc
    ON dc.CustomerID = h.CustomerID
JOIN dw.DimProduct dp
    ON dp.ProductID = d.ProductID
LEFT JOIN dw.DimAddress daShip
    ON daShip.AddressID = h.ShipToAddressID
LEFT JOIN dw.DimAddress daBill
    ON daBill.AddressID = h.BillToAddressID;
